_comment: Reference configuration for the PROD environment Google Chat app. Google Chat does not accept a manifest upload; every value below is entered manually in the Google Cloud Console at: APIs & Services -> Google Chat API -> Configuration (for the app info / functionality / connection / slash commands / visibility sections) and APIs & Services -> Google Workspace Marketplace SDK -> App Configuration (for distribution). See ../README.md for the end-to-end process.

appInfo.description: AI sales assistant. @mention Kai in a space or DM Kai directly for deal insights.

visibility.note: Visibility is driven by the Workspace Marketplace listing (below), not by the Chat API config page, because prod needs cross-domain reach.

serviceAccount.note: No downloaded JSON key. Azure Workload Identity on the AKS backend pod federates to this service account.

storeListing.shortDescription: AI sales assistant for deal insights.
storeListing.detailedDescription: Kai is an AI-powered sales assistant by CopilotGTM. Kai reads your space conversations and provides relevant insights from your deal data, documentation, and meeting notes. @mention Kai in any space or chat with Kai directly for private one-on-one assistance.
